label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Porque yo Jehová Dios de ustedes, y se santificarán, y serán santos, porque santo yo; y no impurificarán sus almas en todo el reptil el reptante sobre la tierra.
spanish: Porque yo Jehová Dios de ustedes, y se santificarán, y serán santos, porque santo yo; y no impurificarán sus almas en todo lo que pulula el reptante sobre la tierra.
grammarChanges: Replaced 'el reptil' with 'lo que pulula' for H8318 הַשֶּׁרֶץ (sourceTokenId h03011044016): matches the licensed swarming/teeming sense already applied to the same lemma in Levítico 11:20, 11:21, 11:23, 11:31, and 11:41, rather than the zoological class Reptilia named by 'reptil'. This also removes the auditor's two-noun reading of 'el reptil el reptante', since 'lo que pulula el reptante' (sourceTokenIds h03011044016, h03011044017) reads as one creeping creature carried by the participle, not two nouns.
readerNote: hold: clause role — בְּ (h03011044015) is only marked as a preposition, and choosing between a locative 'in' and an instrumental 'by means of' reading decides whether the swarming creature is the place or the means of the defiling, so 'en' is left unchanged.
